# DCAStrategyManager
[Git Source](https://github.com/OasisDEX/summer-earn-protocol/blob/main/packages/core-contracts/src/contracts/DCA/DCAStrategyManager.sol)

**Inherits:**
[IDCAStrategyManager](../../interfaces/arks/idca-strategy-manager.md), [IDCAStrategyManagerErrors](../../errors/arks/idca-strategy-manager-errors.md), [IDCAStrategyManagerEvents](../../events/arks/idca-strategy-manager-events.md), ReentrancyGuardTransient, ProtocolAccessManaged, [Permit2Consumer](../../utils/permit2-consumer.md), [EnsoRouterSwapper](../../utils/enso-router-swapper.md), [HarborCommandConsumer](../../utils/harbor-command-consumer.md)

**Title:**
DCAStrategyManager

Manages user-owned dollar-cost-averaging strategies executed by a
permissioned keeper.

The contract holds no funds. Each execution pulls exactly `tradeAmount`
source-vault shares from the strategy owner via Permit2 AllowanceTransfer,
routes them through the Enso aggregator, deposits the proceeds into the
target FleetCommander, and forwards the resulting shares to the owner —
all in a single atomic transaction.
Ownership is proven statelessly: every owner-gated function accepts the
full `StrategyConfig` calldata and verifies that its keccak256 hash
matches the stored commitment, then checks `msg.sender == config.owner`.
There is no separate `_strategyOwners` mapping.


## State Variables
### _MIN_INTERVAL
Minimum allowed interval between executions (1 day).


```solidity
uint256 private constant _MIN_INTERVAL = 1 days
```


### _MAX_INTERVAL
Maximum allowed interval between executions (90 days ≈ 3 months).


```solidity
uint256 private constant _MAX_INTERVAL = 90 days
```


### _MAX_SLIPPAGE_BPS
Maximum allowed slippage in BPS (50%).


```solidity
BPS private constant _MAX_SLIPPAGE_BPS = BPS.wrap(5000)
```


### _nextStrategyId
Monotonically-increasing counter used to assign the next strategy ID.


```solidity
uint256 private _nextStrategyId
```


### strategyCommitments
Maps each strategy ID to its current commitment hash (keccak256 of its config).


```solidity
mapping(uint256 strategyId => bytes32 commitmentHash) public strategyCommitments
```


### _strategyStates
Maps each strategy ID to its mutable runtime state.


```solidity
mapping(uint256 strategyId => StrategyState state) private _strategyStates
```


### activeCommitments
Tracks which commitment hashes are currently active, preventing duplicate strategies.


```solidity
mapping(bytes32 commitmentHash => bool) public activeCommitments
```

### onlyStrategyOwner

Reverts if `config` does not match the stored commitment for
`strategyId` or if the caller is not `config.owner`.


```solidity
modifier onlyStrategyOwner(uint256 strategyId, StrategyConfig calldata config) ;
```

### ownerOnlySender

Reverts if the caller is not `config.owner`.


```solidity
modifier ownerOnlySender(StrategyConfig calldata config) ;
```

### createStrategy

Creates a new DCA strategy with the given configuration.

Assigns a monotonically-increasing strategy ID. The initial
`nextTriggerAt` is set to the next whole-hour boundary plus
`config.interval`, reducing keeper scheduling fragmentation.
Reverts with `DuplicateStrategy` if an identical active commitment
already exists.


```solidity
function createStrategy(StrategyConfig calldata config)
    external
    nonReentrant
    ownerOnlySender(config)
    onlyActiveFleetCommander(config.sourceVault, "source")
    onlyActiveFleetCommander(config.targetVault, "target")
    returns (uint256 strategyId);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`config`|`StrategyConfig`|Fully populated strategy configuration.|

**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`strategyId`|`uint256`|The newly assigned strategy identifier (0-based, sequential).|


### depositAndCreate

Deposits `assetAmount` of `config.inAsset` into `config.sourceVault`
on behalf of the caller, then creates a DCA strategy in the same
transaction.

The deposit goes through the manager only momentarily — the caller
pre-approves the manager for `config.inAsset`, the manager pulls the
assets, approves `config.sourceVault`, and calls
`sourceVault.deposit(assetAmount, msg.sender)` so the resulting
source-vault shares land in the caller's wallet directly.
The Permit2 sub-allowance for future keeper-driven pulls must still
be granted by the caller separately (`Permit2.approve` or `permit`).
Reverts with `ZeroDeposit` if `assetAmount == 0`, and with
`DepositSharesBelowMin` if the minted source-vault shares are below
`expectedMinShares`.
All `createStrategy` validations also apply.


```solidity
function depositAndCreate(
    StrategyConfig calldata config,
    uint256 assetAmount,
    uint256 expectedMinShares
)
    external
    nonReentrant
    ownerOnlySender(config)
    onlyActiveFleetCommander(config.sourceVault, "source")
    onlyActiveFleetCommander(config.targetVault, "target")
    returns (uint256 strategyId);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`config`|`StrategyConfig`|Fully populated strategy configuration.|
|`assetAmount`|`uint256`|Underlying-asset amount to deposit into `config.sourceVault` (denominated in `config.inAsset` native decimals).|
|`expectedMinShares`|`uint256`|Minimum acceptable source-vault shares to mint (caller's off-chain slippage floor; use 0 to skip).|

**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`strategyId`|`uint256`|The newly assigned strategy identifier.|


### createStrategyWithPermit2

Creates a DCA strategy and applies a Permit2 `AllowanceTransfer`
signature to set up the keeper sub-allowance in one transaction.

The caller must have signed an EIP-712 `PermitSingle` over Permit2
naming this contract as the spender and `config.sourceVault` as the
token. The caller must also have previously called
`sourceVaultShares.approve(PERMIT2, max)` once (standard ERC20).
Reverts with `InvalidPermit2Spender` if `permitSingle.spender` is not
this contract, and with `InvalidPermit2Token` if
`permitSingle.details.token != address(config.sourceVault)`.
All `createStrategy` validations also apply.


```solidity
function createStrategyWithPermit2(
    StrategyConfig calldata config,
    IAllowanceTransfer.PermitSingle calldata permitSingle,
    bytes calldata signature
)
    external
    nonReentrant
    ownerOnlySender(config)
    onlyActiveFleetCommander(config.sourceVault, "source")
    onlyActiveFleetCommander(config.targetVault, "target")
    returns (uint256 strategyId);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`config`|`StrategyConfig`|Fully populated strategy configuration.|
|`permitSingle`|`IAllowanceTransfer.PermitSingle`|Permit2 `AllowanceTransfer` data signed by the caller.|
|`signature`|`bytes`|EIP-712 signature over `permitSingle`.|

**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`strategyId`|`uint256`|The newly assigned strategy identifier.|


### depositAndCreateWithPermit2

One-tx variant of `depositAndCreate` that uses Permit2 for both
the initial `inAsset` pull (SignatureTransfer) and the recurring
keeper sub-allowance on source-vault shares (AllowanceTransfer).

The caller signs two off-chain messages bundled in `permits`. The
caller must have previously called `inAsset.approve(PERMIT2, max)`
and `sourceVaultShares.approve(PERMIT2, max)` once each.
Reverts with `ZeroDeposit` if `assetAmount == 0`, with
`InvalidPermit2Spender` / `InvalidPermit2Token` /
`InvalidPermit2Amount` on any of the four required field mismatches,
and with `DepositSharesBelowMin` if the minted source-vault shares are
below `expectedMinShares`.
All `createStrategy` validations also apply.


```solidity
function depositAndCreateWithPermit2(
    StrategyConfig calldata config,
    uint256 assetAmount,
    Permit2DepositBundle calldata permits,
    uint256 expectedMinShares
)
    external
    nonReentrant
    ownerOnlySender(config)
    onlyActiveFleetCommander(config.sourceVault, "source")
    onlyActiveFleetCommander(config.targetVault, "target")
    returns (uint256 strategyId);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`config`|`StrategyConfig`|Fully populated strategy configuration.|
|`assetAmount`|`uint256`|Underlying-asset amount to deposit into `config.sourceVault`.|
|`permits`|`Permit2DepositBundle`|Bundle of the two signed Permit2 messages (see `Permit2DepositBundle`).|
|`expectedMinShares`|`uint256`|Minimum acceptable source-vault shares to mint (caller's off-chain slippage floor; use 0 to skip).|

**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`strategyId`|`uint256`|The newly assigned strategy identifier.|


### editStrategy

Updates a strategy's configuration in place.

The old commitment hash is freed and the new one is registered
atomically. `nextTriggerAt` is recalculated from `lastScheduledAt`
using the new interval.
Ownership transfer via edit is disallowed; cancel and recreate instead.
Reverts with `CommitmentMismatch` if `oldConfig` does not match the stored commitment.
Reverts with `UnauthorizedAccess` if the caller is not `oldConfig.owner` or
if `newConfig.owner != oldConfig.owner`.
Reverts with `DuplicateStrategy` if `newConfig` collides with an existing active commitment.


```solidity
function editStrategy(
    uint256 strategyId,
    StrategyConfig calldata oldConfig,
    StrategyConfig calldata newConfig
)
    external
    nonReentrant
    onlyStrategyOwner(strategyId, oldConfig)
    onlyActiveFleetCommander(newConfig.sourceVault, "source")
    onlyActiveFleetCommander(newConfig.targetVault, "target");
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`strategyId`|`uint256`|Identifier of the strategy to edit.|
|`oldConfig`|`StrategyConfig`|Exact current configuration (must hash to the stored commitment).|
|`newConfig`|`StrategyConfig`|Desired replacement configuration (must pass validation).|


### pauseStrategy

Pauses an active strategy, preventing keeper executions until resumed.

Reverts with `CommitmentMismatch` if `config` does not match the stored commitment.
Reverts with `UnauthorizedAccess` if the caller is not `config.owner`.
Reverts with `StrategyNotActive` if the strategy is not currently ACTIVE.


```solidity
function pauseStrategy(
    uint256 strategyId,
    StrategyConfig calldata config
)
    external
    nonReentrant
    onlyStrategyOwner(strategyId, config);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`strategyId`|`uint256`|Identifier of the strategy to pause.|
|`config`|`StrategyConfig`|Exact current configuration (commitment + ownership proof).|


### resumeStrategy

Resumes a paused strategy and resets `nextTriggerAt` to now + interval.

Reverts with `CommitmentMismatch` if `config` does not match the stored commitment.
Reverts with `UnauthorizedAccess` if the caller is not `config.owner`.
Reverts with `StrategyNotActive` if the strategy is not currently PAUSED.


```solidity
function resumeStrategy(
    uint256 strategyId,
    StrategyConfig calldata config
)
    external
    nonReentrant
    onlyStrategyOwner(strategyId, config);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`strategyId`|`uint256`|Identifier of the strategy to resume.|
|`config`|`StrategyConfig`|Exact current configuration (commitment + ownership proof).|


### cancelStrategy

Permanently cancels a strategy.

Terminal state — the commitment slot is NOT freed, so an identical
config cannot be re-registered without mutating at least one field.
Reverts with `CommitmentMismatch` if `config` does not match the stored commitment.
Reverts with `UnauthorizedAccess` if the caller is not `config.owner`.
Reverts with `StrategyNotActive` if the strategy is already CANCELLED.


```solidity
function cancelStrategy(
    uint256 strategyId,
    StrategyConfig calldata config
)
    external
    nonReentrant
    onlyStrategyOwner(strategyId, config);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`strategyId`|`uint256`|Identifier of the strategy to cancel.|
|`config`|`StrategyConfig`|Exact current configuration (commitment + ownership proof).|


### executeStrategy

Executes a single DCA trade for a strategy.

Callable only by a permissioned keeper. Pulls `config.tradeAmount`
source-vault shares from the owner via Permit2 AllowanceTransfer,
routes them through the Enso aggregator, and forwards the resulting
target-vault shares to the owner — all in a single transaction.
Advances `nextTriggerAt` and increments `tradesExecuted`. Transitions
the strategy to COMPLETED when `maxTrades` is reached or
`nextTriggerAt >= endDate` after the trade.
If `maxTrades` or `endDate` is already exceeded on entry, transitions
the strategy to COMPLETED and emits `StrategyCompleted` without
reverting (no trade is performed).
Reverts with `CommitmentMismatch` if `config` does not match the stored commitment.
Reverts with `StrategyNotActive` if the strategy is not ACTIVE.
Reverts with `ExecutionWindowNotReached` if called before `nextTriggerAt`.


```solidity
function executeStrategy(
    uint256 strategyId,
    StrategyConfig calldata config,
    bytes calldata ensoData
)
    external
    onlyKeeper
    nonReentrant;
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`strategyId`|`uint256`|Identifier of the strategy to execute.|
|`config`|`StrategyConfig`|Exact current configuration (commitment proof).|
|`ensoData`|`bytes`|Calldata forwarded verbatim to the Enso router.|

### checkUpkeep

Off-chain keeper polling function — returns whether a strategy is
ready for execution and what data to supply.

Returns `(false, "")` when any of the following hold:
the strategy is not ACTIVE, the execution window has not been reached,
`maxTrades` is exhausted, `endDate` has passed, or the oracle execution
price falls outside `[minPrice, maxPrice]`.
`performData` is always empty — the keeper supplies `ensoData` off-chain.


```solidity
function checkUpkeep(
    uint256 strategyId,
    StrategyConfig calldata config
)
    external
    view
    returns (bool upkeepNeeded, bytes memory performData);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`strategyId`|`uint256`|Strategy to check.|
|`config`|`StrategyConfig`|Exact current configuration.|

**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`upkeepNeeded`|`bool`|`true` if a keeper call to `executeStrategy` would not revert on preconditions.|
|`performData`|`bytes`|Always empty bytes; Enso calldata is determined off-chain by the keeper.|


### _requirePermit2CoversStrategy

Reverts unless the Permit2 sub-allowance signed by the owner can
cover the worst-case keeper spend (`tradeAmount * maxTrades`) and,
when `endDate > 0`, remains valid until that date. Catches obvious
misconfigurations at create-time instead of mid-strategy reverts.


```solidity
function _requirePermit2CoversStrategy(
    StrategyConfig calldata config,
    IAllowanceTransfer.PermitSingle calldata permitSingle
)
    internal
    pure;
```

### _depositPulledAsset

Approves `sourceVault` for `assetAmount` of `inAsset` already held
by this contract, deposits with `shareReceiver` as the recipient,
and resets the allowance to 0 for hygiene. Caller is responsible
for pulling the assets into this contract beforehand.
Reverts with `DepositSharesBelowMin` when the minted shares are below
`minShares` — the caller's off-chain slippage floor (the vault's own
`previewDeposit` is not a usable reference here since `deposit` mints
exactly that amount in the same call).


```solidity
function _depositPulledAsset(
    IFleetCommander sourceVault,
    IERC20 inAsset,
    address shareReceiver,
    uint256 assetAmount,
    uint256 minShares
)
    internal;
```

### _requireNonTerminal

Reverts with `StrategyNotActive` if `status` is one of the terminal
states (CANCELLED, COMPLETED). Shared by `editStrategy` and
`cancelStrategy`.


```solidity
function _requireNonTerminal(uint256 strategyId, Status status) internal pure;
```

### _markCompleted

Flips a strategy to `COMPLETED` and emits `StrategyCompleted`.
Centralises the state-write + event-emit pair used by all
terminal-transition sites (pre-flight in `executeStrategy` and
post-trade in `_executeSwap`).


```solidity
function _markCompleted(uint256 strategyId, StrategyState storage state, bytes32 reason) internal;
```

### _createStrategy

Shared body for `createStrategy` and `depositAndCreate`. Assumes the
caller-side modifier stack (`ownerOnlySender`, `onlyActiveFleetCommander` x2)
has already run; performs field validation, duplicate-commitment guard,
ID allocation, state initialization, and emission.


```solidity
function _createStrategy(StrategyConfig calldata config) internal returns (uint256 strategyId);
```

### _hourAlignedTimestamp

Rounds `block.timestamp` up to the next whole hour boundary.


```solidity
function _hourAlignedTimestamp() internal view returns (uint256);
```

### _commitmentHash

Returns the commitment hash for `config` — keccak256(abi.encode(config)).


```solidity
function _commitmentHash(StrategyConfig calldata config) internal pure returns (bytes32);
```

### _validateStrategyConfig

Validates the fields of `config` that are independent of vault registry
checks (those are enforced by the `onlyActiveFleetCommander` modifier).
Reverts with `InvalidOwner`, `SameAsset`, `IntervalTooShort`,
`IntervalTooLong`, `InvalidSlippage`, `ZeroTradeAmount`, `ZeroMaxTrades`,
or `InvalidFeedAddress` on the first failing field.


```solidity
function _validateStrategyConfig(StrategyConfig calldata config) internal view;
```

### _executeStrategy

Fetches oracle prices, enforces price-guard bounds, pulls funds from
the owner via Permit2, then delegates to `_executeSwap`.
Reverts with `PriceAboveCeiling` or `PriceBelowFloor` when the
current execution price falls outside the strategy's configured bounds.


```solidity
function _executeStrategy(
    uint256 strategyId,
    StrategyConfig calldata config,
    bytes calldata ensoData,
    StrategyState storage state
)
    internal;
```

### _executeSwap

CEI sequence for the swap mechanics of a single DCA trade: advance
state, route source shares through Enso, verify `minOut`, transfer
target shares to the owner, refund any unused source shares. Lifecycle
decisions (terminal-state transition, event emission) are handled by
the caller. Reverts with `SwapOutputBelowMinOut` when received shares
are below the slippage-adjusted minimum.
`sourceSharesBaseline` is the manager's source-vault share balance
captured by the caller before pulling funds. Any source shares left
in the contract above this baseline after the Enso call are returned
to `config.owner` — defending the "no funds held between txs"
invariant against routers that underspend the approval.


```solidity
function _executeSwap(
    uint256 strategyId,
    StrategyConfig calldata config,
    bytes calldata ensoData,
    StrategyState storage state,
    uint256 minOut,
    uint256 sourceSharesBaseline
)
    internal
    returns (
        uint256 swappedAmount,
        uint256 outAssets,
        uint256 nextTriggerAt,
        uint248 tradesExecuted,
        uint256 actualInShares
    );
```
